cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate: C1 chassis. Defining anionic Sodium Laureth Sulfate @2; three prominent buffers (Cocamidopropyl Betaine @3, Decyl Glucoside @4, Coco-Glucoside @5); no reinforcing strong anionic.

conditioningLevel.rationale: High: C2 met with a payload lipid in place of the silicone. Prominent payload lipids Squalane @9, Cocos Nucifera Oil @11, Dicaprylyl Ether @12, Hydrogenated Castor Oil @18; cationic polymer Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride @13; pearlizing route Glycol Distearate @17; listed humectants Panthenol @10, Glycerin @15. W-RICH (E3 reading) also holds. Counter-signal: every conditioning element sits in the mid/late list (positions 9-18) behind three surfactants and citric acid, so bounded care (moderate) remains realistic.
